name: order_status
definition: Asking where an order is or for an ETA, with no complaint yet that anything is wrong.

name: delivery_problem
definition: The delivery itself failed: late, missing, misdelivered, or a rude/careless courier; 'delivered' but not actually received.

name: refund_or_return
definition: Wants money back or wants to send an item back, including A-to-z Guarantee claims.

name: cancellation_or_change
definition: Cancel or modify an order, or report that AmazonHelp/the seller cancelled one.

name: billing_or_payment
definition: Wrong, duplicate, or unexplained charge; payment declined; gift card can't be used; unauthorized charge.

name: product_defect
definition: The physical item or device itself is broken, wrong, or not as described (not a delivery failure).

name: account_access
definition: Login, password, suspended/locked account, or phishing/fraud emails.

name: app_or_site_technical
definition: A site or app feature, or a checkout option, is broken or missing.

name: digital_content
definition: Kindle, Prime Video, Alexa/Echo software, or other digital-purchase content issues (not hardware malfunctions).

name: subscription_membership
definition: Prime membership signup, benefits, renewal, or cancellation.

name: general_feedback_or_praise
definition: Venting or praise with no specific actionable request attached.

name: other
definition: Doesn't fit any of the above - policy/legal questions, contests, unrelated social posts.
